title: Operator-friendly Mission Control UI v1
description: After completing any earlier Bridge infrastructure sync task, update ONLY these AI Studio workspace files so they exactly match GitHub main: src/types.ts, server/missionControl.ts, src/components/MissionControlView.tsx. This UI upgrade is for the human operator: show device-local clock/timezone, live elapsed task duration, current stage/progress, clear 'what Bridge is doing', clear 'what you need to do now', actionable Gemini blocked/stale explanations with copyable recovery instructions, client-local activity timestamps, and correct AI Studio relay status inference from real heartbeat/progress even if GEMINI_EXTERNAL_AGENT_ENABLED is not set. Do NOT replace package.json or server.ts because the Studio workspace has deployment-specific startup changes. Do NOT edit data/bridge.sqlite. Do NOT delete or recreate runtime task history. Run npm run lint and npm run build, restart Preview, verify GET /health returns status ok, and visually inspect the Mission Control page for obvious layout/runtime errors. Do not redesign unrelated tabs. Do not publish automatically; report that the workspace is ready for one final Republish after all pending Bridge sync tasks are complete.
